newsitem.title: UK: Laporte gains after year-end review.
newsitem.headline: Laporte gains after year-end review.

text.p: Shares in Laporte Plc jumped higher in early trading on Thursday after the company said in its year-end review that trading was in line with expectations in the second half of 1996.
The stock was up 19-1/2p at 654 by 0829 GMT.

Today's rise came after Laporte shares yesterday tumbled to their their lowest close since February, after an extended decline after the company in September reported almost halved first-half pre-tax profits of 36.4 million stg.

Laporte said that whilst trading conditions remain competitive, the international spread of its businesses, together with the strong market and technology positions in specialist sector, gave a base for solid progress in the year as a whole.
Traders said today's gain in the stock essentially reflected relief that the statement was not as bearish as anticipated.
"People had been a bit too cautious beforehand," said one market-maker in the stock. "Everyone had been expecting a terrible report and it was not quite as bad as expected."
Said another: "The stock has been under a bit of pressure and this is just a technical rebound."
By 0915 GMT the stock was up 29-1/2p at 664 in thin volume of 17,243 shares.
